title: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont
subtitle: Modeling studies
summary: Terrain-modeling studies of Adolphe Alphand's 1867 Paris park — its cliffs, lake, and belvedere island rebuilt as contour models in chipboard and resin alongside digital contour mapping. [CONFIRM details]

sections.heading: Study
sections.body: [CONFIRM] Reading dramatic constructed topography through physical modeling: stacked-contour studies, a fold-out chipboard model, and a 3D resin print of the quarry landform around the lake and island.
